data.description: Create a work item to refactor the code produced for the first three enemy gym scenes. This refactoring will identify opportunities for code reuse accross the scenes and will create work items, of high priority, for extracting this reusable code into core libraries. Each gym scene will be rewritten to use the core libraries. A new document ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md will be created which will contain best practive recommendations for using these libraries. The remaining work items to create enemy gym scenes will be updated to adhere to these best practices. This refactor work item will be dependent on the first three enemy gym scenes and will be critical priority.
data.title: Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes

data.description:
Save button writes sliders to config file

## Goal

AC3 of parent AH-0MT9FS3DL0084Z6V: a Save button persists the current slider values to the config file via the config module, with success/failure feedback.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Save button:** The gym UI panel renders a Save button.
- [ ] **AC2 — Persists values:** Clicking Save calls saveShipConfig(currentValues) where currentValues are the panel slider/color values; values survive reload (loadShipConfig returns them).
- [ ] **AC3 — Feedback:** A status message (e.g. "Saved") appears on success; error shows failure text.
- [ ] **AC4 — Tests:** happy-dom test clicks Save, asserts saveShipConfig persisted to localStorage key ai-hell-ship-config and a status message rendered.

## Key Files

- src/scenes/Gym.ts
- src/core/config.ts (saveShipConfig)
